title: Draw Order and Overdraw Stepper
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Examine a sequence of FrameBuf draw calls step by step to differentiate which pixels remain visible in the final image from which pixels were drawn and then overdrawn by a later call.

learningObjectives: Examine a sequence of FrameBuf draw calls step by step to differentiate which pixels remain visible in the final image from which pixels were drawn and then overdrawn by a later call.
